name: print-social-eye-catching-designs-stories-pastel-flat-illustration-tools
title: 'Transforming Ideas into Eye-Catching Designs' story set in pastel with flat-illustrated design tools
whatItIs: Four vertical story cards alternating cream, purple and pink pastels, each with a flat illustration of oversized design tools (a giant pencil, a laptop with a portrait, colour swatches, a camera and ruler), and headlines ('Need graphic design services?', 'Need Creative solutions for your company?', 'Unlock Your Brand's Visual Potential').
whatItMeans: Friendly and reassuring; oversized familiar tools make abstract creative services feel concrete and approachable.
techniques: Scale a design tool larger than life as the hero prop.
Alternate pastel background colours across a story set.
Colour one key phrase within each headline for emphasis.

vocabulary.definition: An object illustrated larger than realistic scale for visual impact.
